text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm walking down the hall
during lunch
when I see Narita Brian
putting up posters.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sigh... That's one-third down... Two-thirds left to go.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe the vice president is
putting up all
those posters by herself...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right... We should go see if
she
needs help.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me! Do you need any―

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What do you want?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Eek! N-nothing! Never mind...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That glare of hers is so potent... It's
enough to
keep anyone away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
L-let's get out of here. She looks like
she's in a
bad mood. We'll just make it
worse.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh? Not you too...
choice_data_list: 何か悪いことしたのか？

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm just here on student council business.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, I am one, more or less.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, I need to get all these posters
up by
today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't have time to talk, so buzz off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I don't have time to talk, so buzz off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not really. I can do it just fine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: 2人ならすぐ終わるんじゃないか？
2人ならすぐ終わるんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm tired of arguing. Help if you want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll go clockwise around school. You go

counterclockwise. Be quick about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is blunt with her words, but
she
seems more than capable of
handling her student
council duties.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I just think of it as training to get
something out
of it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, see ya. I've got work to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being tedious and tiring work,
Narita
Brian completes her student
council duties
diligently.
